answer: A sybil-resistant economy can use a web-of-trust graph: every agent is a vertex whose reputation comes only from endorsements by established agents, each endorsement backed by a small stake that is slashed if the endorsee misbehaves. A fresh fake identity starts isolated, like a still lagoon cut off from the gale of real transactions, so it cannot earn trust quickly. An attacker must buy or farm many genuine endorsements, each costing stake and time, making a thousand fake agents far more expensive than the value they can extract.
